headline: Banking operations, clearly organized.
body: A focused environment for customer accounts, staff operations, access control, and audit history.
customerBody: Customers see only their own accounts, balances, and transfers.
staffBody: Tellers, managers, and auditors each work inside a defined set of permissions.
auditBody: Money movements and access changes keep a separate, traceable history.
securityBody: Customer isolation, staff permissions, and administrator controls are enforced by the API.
demoBody: Public test accounts are documented in the repository. They belong only to the isolated demo dataset.
footer: Educational demonstration. Not a production bank.
